column1: # privileged.tsv: what the sudo dispatcher (src/shims/sudo) does with each
# privileged call of an Upstream command. Installed as
# One line per Upstream bin/ command that has privileged findings in the
# <pattern> is a bash extended glob matched against the command sudo would
# run and its arguments, joined by single spaces. The first matching line of
# the calling command wins; a call that matches no line is unsupported.
#   allow        runs /usr/bin/sudo with the original arguments. Only for
#                calls that change no persistent state.
#   override     the command is replaced by a Motanka override, which goes
#                through the Helper or reports that it is not available.
#   unsupported  exit 64, journal entry, notification "<command> is not
# Calls of pacman, yay, mkinitcpio, limine-* and snapper never reach this
# table: the dispatcher runs those shims, and any override, unprivileged.
